theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only eligible theme that is NOT crowded and shows a mean-revert hurst tag with a moderate durability bar (0.46) and positive breadth (0.3). Because the trend gate whipsaws on this mean-reverting tape, a mean-revert tag with positive breadth is more aligned with this market's actual behavior than the trend-tagged leaders. The lean is a direction toward resilience, not a return forecast.
evidence: hurst_tag='mean-revert' (only eligible theme with this tag)
theses.dissent: Banks and Pharma dominate all attention and flow (scores 0.998/0.988), so laggard Coal could simply be left behind as leadership stays narrow and cash stays in the top two.

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Semiconductors is eligible and trend-tagged but shows very low breadth (0.091) and sits mid-rank (8) with only a 0.315 score, meaning weak participation despite trend health. theses.dissent: Capitulation low breadth can precede a sharp trend continuation, and AI/tech flow can rotate to semis arbitrarily; the tag is coincident only.
